title: Dragon Vein Awakening
next_chapter_hook: The Crown Prince's spies have already begun secretly investigating the truth behind Chen Ji's death, and a political storm involving the fate of the dynasty is about to sweep through.

text.content: Before the warmth of the ancient characters had fully faded, Chen Ji discovered a blank space at the very end of the contract that had never been filled in—where another name should have been inscribed. His fingertip hovered in the void, gazing at that emptiness, and a chill stirred in his heart. Signing the Executor's Contract was supposed to be a crucial step in his scheme, yet this blank space was like a crack, hinting at some truth he had yet to grasp.

Just then, the dragon vein mark on his chest suddenly burned with searing heat. That warmth was as if a volcano dormant for a thousand years had awakened, surging upward against the meridians, causing bones to tremble and flesh to seethe wherever it passed. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, and a majestic power erupted from the depths of his dantian, creating some eerie resonance with the ancient characters on the contract.

dialogue.content: Could this be... the premonition of a second dragon vein awakening?

text.content: He immediately sat cross-legged, guiding that violent power. Strangely, this force was not as rebellious and untamable as before; instead, guided by the contract, it became docile, flowing into his limbs like a hundred rivers returning to the sea. The meridians of the Tianqing Sect servant expanded rapidly under the scouring of this power, and every acupuncture point emitted crisp resonant sounds.

Great Vehicle Stage! Chen Ji felt the barrier of his realm crumble under the impact of the dragon vein power, and an unprecedented sense of fullness filled his entire body. His divine sense instantly covered a hundred li in all directions, and every corner of the Tianqing Sect was under his control. This was the magnificent power of a Great Vehicle cultivator—capable of shaking mountains and filling seas with a mere gesture.

dialogue.content: Excellent, the timing of the dragon vein awakening is just right.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice drifted from the Tianji Record Fragment, carrying the weight of ten thousand years. Chen Ji opened his eyes, golden dragon patterns faintly flowing in his pupils, his aura more than ten times stronger than before. He looked down at his own hands, dragon scale patterns faintly visible beneath his skin, radiating a faint ancient majestic presence.

choice.prompt: The power boost from the dragon vein awakening greatly increased Chen Ji's confidence. What should he do next?

choices.description: Strike while the iron is hot, rush to the imperial capital to investigate the opposition between the Crown Prince and the Princess, seize the initiative.
choices.visible_reward: Seize the Initiative in Political Chess
choices.risk_hint: The imperial capital runs deep; rushing in may lead to being surrounded by multiple forces.

text.content: A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips as the Great Vehicle aura was released outward, the corners of his servant's robe fluttering without wind. He decided to use this confidence brought by the power and step directly into the deep waters of the imperial capital.
However, the moment he stepped out of the Tianqing Sect, he sensed several concealed divine senses sweep over him—someone was already watching him.

choices.description: Act low-key, gather intelligence on the imperial court's internal affairs first, understand the cards held by the Crown Prince and Princess before making plans.
choices.risk_hint: May miss the deterrent timing brought by the dragon vein awakening, allowing enemies to lay out their schemes first.

text.content: Chen Ji收敛气息，将mahayana境的imposing尽数内敛，重新变回那个懦弱的废材杂役弟子。他唤来几名暗桩，开始系统性地搜集皇朝内部的情报。

However, after the intelligence was compiled, his brow furrowed—the confrontation between the Crown Prince and Princess was far more complex than he had imagined, and the movements of the Demonic Path commander revealed an inexplicable sense of the uncanny.

choices.text: Turn the Force Against Its Wielder
choices.description: Use the prestige of the dragon vein awakening to create a fake death illusion, draw out the snakes, and force enemies to reveal themselves.
choices.visible_reward: Draw Out Hidden Enemies, Seize the Initiative
choices.risk_hint: If enemies see through the scheme, they may turn the tables.

text.content: A cunning glint flashed in Chen Ji's eyes as he used his Great Vehicle cultivation to create an 'accident,' spreading his 'death' across all directions.

On the third day after the news spread, the imperial capital indeed showed signs of activity—both the Crown Prince's residence and the Princess's residence sent people to the Tianqing Sect, ostensibly to offer condolences, but actually to probe the truth.

In the Chengtian Hall of the imperial capital. In the golden splendor of the great hall, a young man dressed in bright yellow python robes sat upright in the main seat, his face like a carved jade yet his gazegloomy—那就是大周太子周承渊。他的指尖轻轻敲击着扶手，嘴角噙着一抹amused的笑。

dialogue.content: Thattrash杂役 from the Tianqing Sect, dead?

text.content: Your Highness, this matter is likely a trap. Chen Ji's death was too suspicious, occurring right after the dragon vein disturbance—this smacks of someone laying a trap.

dialogue.content: Your Highness, this matter is likely a trap. Chen Ji's death was too suspicious, occurring right after the dragon vein disturbance—this smacks of someone laying a trap.

text.content: Beside the Crown Prince, a strategist whispered his counsel. However, the Crown Prince merely waved his hand, his gaze falling on the other side of the hall, where a woman in phoenix robes stood—Princess Zhou Fengming, equally focused on this news. The siblings' eyes met, and invisible sparks seemed to fly in the air between them.

Meanwhile, in the Demonic Path army camp. Inside the central command tent, a graceful figure sat behind black纱帐，隐约可见其绝美容颜。魔道主帅——夜清。帐外斥候来报："禀圣女，天青宗龙脉异动，疑似有人突破mahayana境。"黑纱帐后，夜清的嘴角slightly上扬，眼中闪过一丝complex的光芒。

dialogue.content: Is it him... He's finally reached this point.

text.content: Ye Qing slowly rose, casually brushing aside the black纱帐，露出一张足以祸国殃民的绝美面容。她望向天青宗的方向，眼中闪过一丝追忆——那个男人曾向她展示过一段预言，预言中她看见了命运的真相，看见了所谓的"命运双生子"。

dialogue.content: Send the order—pull the army back thirty li. Additionally... keep a close eye on the Crown Prince's residence and Princess's residence. This one wishes to see how they play their cards.

text.content: However, at this very moment, a commotion erupted outside the tent. A blood-soaked Demonic Path scout stumbled in, trembling as he reported: 'Saint Lady! Xuanwu Sect's number one genius Han Lie has suddenly led his army to raid our left flank, momentum overwhelming—we've already had three defensive lines breached!' Ye Qing's brow furrowed slightly, a cold glint flickering in her eyes.
Indeed, it is Han Lie. Ye Qingsneered一声，正欲调兵迎战，帐外又传来一阵heavy的脚步声。一名身披黑色斗篷的身影缓步走入，正是圣宗的残魂守护者——墨先生的另一位"故人"。

From beneath the cloak came an aged, icy voice: 'Saint Lady, this old servant was ordered to remind you—the one you call your collaborator, Chen Ji, is already dead. And you, it seems, have yet to fulfill your contract with the Holy Sect.' Ye Qing's pupils contracted slightly, and the surrounding temperature dropped several degrees.

She slowly turned, fixing her gaze on the shadow beneath the hood, demonic energy churning within her like a raging sea. A terrifying aura erupted from her body, and the entire command tent trembled beneath this pressure.

dialogue.content: Contract? This one's contract with the Holy Sect is to deal with the Eye of Heavenly Mandate, not some Chen Ji. Besides—dead or not, this one knows better than you.

text.content: The hooded elder seemed to feel the terror of that aura and took a slight step back. Ye Qing stepped forward, gently lifting her delicate hand, a blade of jet-black demonic energy forming and pressing against the old man's throat.

dialogue.content: Go back and tell those old unkillable things from the Holy Sect—Chen Ji's affairs are this one's own concern. Dare to meddle again—and this one won't mind the Holy Sect getting a new Saint Lady.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing confronts the Holy Sect envoy. How should Chen Ji respond to this sudden turn of events?

choices.description: Ye Qing is his important ally; cannot let her fall into trouble. Secretly intervene to deter the Holy Sect envoy.
choices.risk_hint: May expose the 'fake death' truth, drawing attention from more factions

text.content: Just as the atmosphere reached the point of swords being drawn, a gentle voice sounded in the void: 'Ye Qing Saint Lady, why be so agitated? This senior was merely following orders.' Chen Ji's figure slowly emerged from the虚空，smiling.

The hooded elder's pupils dilated as he gasped: 'You... you're not dead?!' Chen Ji smiled faintly, Great Vehicle aura pouring out like a tide, enveloping the old man. The elder's face instantly turned ashen, his knees buckled, and he involuntarily knelt.

choices.description: Ye Qing is no simple woman; she can handle this herself. Observe the Holy Sect's true intentions in the shadows, gather intelligence.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain More Intelligence on Holy Sect's Conspiracy
choices.risk_hint: If Ye Qing handles it poorly, the alliance may suffer cracks

text.content: Chen Ji收敛气息，隐于虚空之中，冷眼旁观这一切。他想看看夜清会如何处理这突如其来的变故，同时也在暗中收集圣宗使者的情报。

Ye Qing's demonic blade pressed another fraction deeper into the old man's throat, a trickle of blood sliding down the blade. 'Speak—what does the Holy Sect really want?' Her voice was cold as the nine yin hells. The elder finally relented, quietly confessing part of the Holy Sect's plan.

choices.text: Kill Two Birds with One Stone
choices.description: Use this opportunity to have Ye Qing eliminate the Holy Sect envoy, while solidifying his 'death' status—a two-pronged gain.
choices.visible_cost: Completely Become Enemies with the Holy Sect
choices.visible_reward: Eliminate Potential Threats While Continuing to Hide Strength
choices.risk_hint: The Holy Sect's power is vast; killing their envoy may bring greater retaliation

text.content: Chen Ji quietly inscribed a talisman in the void, and that符文 silently merged into the Holy Sect envoy's body. His purpose was not to kill, but to leave a tracking mark within the man.

However, Ye Qing seemed to misunderstand his intent. Her demonic blade swept across, directly severing the old man's head. Blood gushed forth, staining her snow-white hem. She turned to gaze into the void, a faint smile on her lips: 'Chen Ji, since you're here, why hide in the shadows?'
Chen Jihelpless一笑，从虚空中走出。"夜清圣女的感知越发敏锐了。"他拱了拱手，目光落在地上的尸体上，眉头微皱。"不过，杀了圣宗使者，后果可能比你想象的更严重。"夜清擦了擦手上的血迹，满不在乎地说："不过是圣宗的一条狗罢了，杀了便杀了。"

Yet Chen Ji noticed another detail—the old man's expression before death was not fear, but a strange sense of relief. This stirred an uneasy feeling within him. He thought of the blank space at the end of the contract, of the repeatedly mentioned concept of 'Twin Children of Fate,' and a terrible suspicion took shape in his heart.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing, the prophecy you mentioned before—Twin Children of Fate—what does it actually mean?
Do you truly wish to know?

text.content: Ye Qing turned, fixing her gaze on Chen Ji's eyes, a complex light flickering within them. 'Chen Ji, do you know the whereabouts of your sister Chen Nian?' Chen Ji's heart sank heavily—that was his greatest weakness, the only burden he could not release since crossing into this world.

dialogue.content: Do you know where Nian Nian is?

text.content: Ye Qing沉默了片刻，从袖中取出一枚玉简，递给陈机。"这是我从一个圣宗长老记忆中剥离出的信息。上面说……陈念是天道之眼选中的'天命锁钥'，而你——"她顿了顿，眼中闪过一丝怜悯，"你是她的双生兄弟，'命运双生子'中的另一个。"
Chen Ji接过玉简，神识探入其中。一瞬间，无数画面涌入他的脑海——陈念被囚禁在圣宗最深处的禁地，周身缠绕着无数金色的锁链。而在她的对面，还有一道模糊的身影，与她血脉相连，命运交织。

dialogue.content: This can't be... Nian Nian she...

text.content: Ye Qing sighed and continued: 'Twin Children of Fate—one bears Heavenly Mandate, the other bears Heavenly Punishment. Your fates are intertwined; when one thrives, both thrive, when one perishes, both perish. And what the Holy Sect and the Eye of Heavenly Mandate truly want is not merely Chen Nian, this 'Lock Key'—they want to control both siblings.' Chen Ji's fists clenched tight, his knuckles white. He finally understood the meaning of that blank space—it was not a space left for someone else, but for the other half of the 'Twin Children of Fate.'

He raised his gaze toward the sky, as if through layers of void he could see those eyes that had been watching him from the shadows. 'Eye of Heavenly Mandate...' His voice was low and cold, 'This debt, I will remember.' Ye Qing watched his expression and suddenly smiled. 'It seems I was not mistaken in you.' She extended her hand, 'Chen Ji, from this day forth, the Demonic Path Holy Sect and Tianqing Sect formally form an alliance. We share a common enemy—the Eye of Heavenly Mandate.'

choice.prompt: Facing Ye Qing's alliance invitation, how should Chen Ji choose?

choices.description: The Demonic Path faction is powerful; with Ye Qing as an ally, the success rate of finding Chen Nian will greatly increase.
choices.visible_cost: Bear the Name of the Demonic Path
choices.visible_reward: Gain a Powerful Ally, Strengthen筹码 Against the Eye of Heavenly Mandate
choices.risk_hint: May face rejection from orthodox factions, Reputation damaged

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate, extending his hand to clasp Ye Qing's. Their palms met in the air with a crisp sound. A strange resonance emanated from both palms—that was the mark of intertwined fates.

'Deal.' Chen Ji smiled faintly, 'However, before that, I must make a trip to the imperial capital. The dragon vein struggle between the Crown Prince and Princess may be an excellent opportunity to draw out the Eye of Heavenly Mandate.'

choices.description: Alliance is a major matter requiring careful deliberation. First scout the imperial capital, then decide.
choices.visible_cost: May Miss the Best Timing for Alliance
choices.visible_reward: Maintain Flexibility, Avoid Being Drawn Into Demonic Path vs. Orthodox Struggles Prematurely
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may think Chen Ji lacks sincerity, affecting the alliance

text.content: Chen Ji沉吟片刻，slightly摇头。"夜清，结盟之事不急于一时。我需要先处理皇都的事情，确认局势后再做决定。"夜清眼中闪过一丝失望，但很快恢复如常。

'Very well, you have your considerations.' She turned toward the tent entrance, 'But there's something you must remember—Han Lie's army is already approaching. If not dealt with in time, there will likely be a brutal battle.'

Just then, a thunderous roar erupted outside the tent. A golden figure descended from the heavens, shattering the central command tent's dome, and landed before the two. It was none other than Xuanwu Sect's number one genius Han Lie. Covered in blood, his eyes burned with mad battle intent, fixed squarely on Chen Ji.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji! I knew you weren't dead! I knew a sinister character like you wouldn't die so easily!

text.content: Han Lie's周身气势暴涨，玄武真意化作一头巨大的玄龟虚影，将他整个人笼罩其中。他是来找陈机算账的——上次被陈机设计，在众目睽睽之下颜面尽失，这份耻辱他铭记于心。

dialogue.content: Han Lie, the grudge between us, I had planned to settle it in the future. Unfortunately... you insisted on delivering yourself to my door.

text.content: Chen Ji stepped forward, Great Vehicle aura pressing down on Han Lie like a mountain. Yet Han Lie actually withstood this pressure, not retreating a single step. A flash of surprise crossed his eyes, quickly replaced by fiercer battle intent.

dialogue.content: Great Vehicle Stage? Hmph, today Han Lie will see what right atrash like you has to stand alongside me!

text.content: Before the words even finished, Han Lie had already struck. His fist blasted outward, Xuanwu Intent transforming into a monstrous wave, carrying world-shattering might toward Chen Ji. This was his signature technique—Xuanwu Suppresses the Sea! Ye Qing's brow furrowed slightly, about to intervene, when Chen Ji raised a hand to stop her.

dialogue.content: No need. I'd rather see how much substance the Xuanwu Sect's number one genius truly has.

text.content: Chen Ji's right hand slowly rose, and the dragon vein mark on the back of his hand blazed brightly. A low dragon's roar emanated from within his body, followed by a golden dragon's phantom rising behind him, confronting the monstrous wave head-on. Dragon and turtle collided in midair, producing a world-shaking roar.

Han Lie's face instantly changed dramatically. He felt his proud Xuanwu Intent crumbling like paper against the golden dragon's assault, retreating inch by inch. 'Impossible!' He roared, trying to stabilize himself, but it was already too late.

The golden dragon opened its vast maw and swallowed the Xuanwu phantom whole. Han Lie's body was struck like lightning, a mouthful of blood spraying from his lips as he was sent flying backward, crashing through several camp tents before barely coming to a stop.

One move. In just one move, Xuanwu Sect's number one genius was defeated by Chen Ji. The Demonic Path disciples watching from around were stunned speechless, then erupted into earth-shaking cheers. Han Lie knelt half-crouched on the ground, trembling all over, his eyes filled with indignation and humiliation.

dialogue.content: Han Lie, do you know why you always lose to me?

text.content: Han Lieabruptly抬头，双目赤红，咬牙切齿地说："你不过是仗着那些阴谋诡计！有本事与我正面一战！"陈机轻笑一声，缓步走向韩烈。"正面一战？"他俯视着这个曾经不可一世的对手，眼中闪过一丝怜悯。"你以为你输在计谋上？不，你输在格局上。"

With that, he turned and walked away without giving Han Lie another glance. 'Send him back to the Xuanwu Sect.' He instructed without turning his head, 'Tell the Xuanwu Sect's higher-ups that Chen Ji sends his regards.' Ye Qing followed behind him, a playful smile on her lips. 'You certainly are confident. Are you not afraid of Xuanwu Sect's retaliation?'
